'''Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards''' was a ship manufacturer.

==History==
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the two companies [[Rendili Hyperworks/Legends|Rendili Hyperworks]] and [[Vanjervalis Systems]] joined together to create the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ship]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], using a Vanjervalis super computer inside a Rendili ship-frame. One of its shipbuilding sites was at [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
